segments.he:
א.

בִּגְדֵי אָדָם מְרַמְּזִים עַל מִדּוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם.
segments.en: A persons clothes hint at his character traits.

segments.he:
ב.

מִי שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ יָחֵף, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁהוּא חוֹטֵא.
segments.en: One who goes barefoot, it is certain that he sins.

segments.he:
ג.

עַל-יְדֵי עַזּוּת-מֶצַח נֶעֱנָשׁ בִּבְגָדִים גַּם עַל- יְדֵי שְׁבוּעוֹת.
segments.en: As a result of brazenness, one is punished through his clothes, also due to [false] oaths.

segments.he:
ד.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ נִזְהָר לְהִסְתַּכֵּל בְּעֶרְוַת אָבִיו, לְסוֹף שֶׁיֵּלְכוּ בָּנָיו "עָרוֹם וְיָחֵף".
segments.en: One who is not careful not to look at his father's nakedness, in the end his children will go naked and barefoot.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁאוֹכֵל קֹדֶם הַתְּפִלָּה, הוּא נֶעֱנָשׁ בִּבְגָדִים.
segments.en: One who eats before the prayer is punished through his clothes.

segments.he:
ו.

עַל-יְדֵי גַּאֲוָה נֶעֱנָשׁ בִּבְגָדִים.
segments.en: Due to arrogance, one is punished through his clothes.

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁמֵּסִית אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ מִדֶּרֶךְ הַטּוֹבָה לְדֶרֶךְ הָרָעָה, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה אֵין לוֹ בַּמֶּה לִלְבּשׁ.
segments.en: One who seduces his friend away from the right path to the wrong one, will consequently not have with what to clothe himself.

segments.he:
ח.

מִי שֶׁהוּא עָרֵב בְּעַד עַכּוּ"ם, הוּא נֶעֱנָשׁ בִּבְגָדִים.
segments.en: One who is a guarantor for a non-Jew is punished through his clothing.

segments.he:
ט.

לֶעָתִיד הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא יְהֵא נִפְרָע מֵאוֹתָם הַמְּלֻבָּשִׁים מַלְבּוּשׁ עַכּוּ"ם.
segments.en: In the future, the Holy One Blessed be He will be avenged from those who dressed in the clothing of non-Jews.

segments.he:
י.



מִי שֶׁהוֹלֵךְ בִּבְגָדִים קְרוּעִים מֵחֲמַת עֲנִיּוּת, תַּקָּנָתוֹ - הַבְּכִיָּה לִפְנֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: One who goes in torn clothing due to poverty, his rectification is (through) weeping before the Blessed L-rd.

segments.he:
יא.

כָּל הַמְבַזֶּה בְּגָדִים, לְסוֹף אֵינוֹ נֶהֱנֶה מֵהֶם.
segments.en: All who treat clothes with disrespect will end up not benefiting from them.

segments.he:
יב.

מִי שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה מַלְבּוּשׁ לְעָנִי, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה נִצּוֹל מִבִּזְיוֹנוֹת.
segments.en: One who makes a garment for a poor person will be saved from humiliations.

segments.he:
יג.

מִי שֶׁהוּא נִזְהָר מִלְּבַיֵּשׁ שׁוּם אָדָם, זוֹכֶה לְמַלְבּוּשִׁים.
segments.en: One who is wary not to embarrass any man merits garments. Through being silent, one will merit to trust (in G-d).

segments.he: חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי

א.

עַל-יְדֵי סִפּוּרֵי-מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים מַמְשִׁיכִין אוֹרוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ בָּעוֹלָם, וְדוֹחֶה הַרְבֵּה חשֶׁךְ וְצָרוֹת מִן הָעוֹלָם גַּם זוֹכֶה לִבְגָדִים נָאִים.
segments.en: Through [telling] stories of Tzaddikim, the light of Messiah is drawn into the world, much darkness and troubles are dispelled from the world, and one also merits having attractive clothing.

segments.he:
ב.

הָרָגִיל בִּקְלָלָה, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה לֹא יִהְיֶה לוֹ בְּגָדִים עַל שַׁבָּת.
segments.en: One who is accustomed to cursing, through this he will not have clothes for Shabbat. One who always beautifies his legs with fine garments, for example, wearing ostentatious shoes or pants, through this he comes to deceive others.

segments.he:
ג.

מִי שֶׁמְּיַפֶּה תָּמִיד אֶת רַגְלָיו בִּלְבוּשִׁין נָאִים, לְמָשָׁל בְּמִנְעָלִים יָפִים בְּיוֹתֵר אוֹ בְּמִכְנָסַיִם, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה בָּא לִגְנֵבַת הַדָּעַת.
segments.en: One who is negligent (disrespectful) in the commandment of Tzitzit does not merit burial.

segments.he:
ד.

הַמְזַלְזֵל בְּמִצְוַת צִיצִית, אֵינוֹ זוֹכֶה לִקְבוּרָה.
segments.en: One who makes clothing for his friend can change his friend's will in any way he wants, both materially and spiritually.

segments.he:
ה.

הָעוֹשֶׂה בְּגָדִים לַחֲבֵרוֹ, יָכוֹל לְשַׁנּוֹת רְצוֹן חֲבֵרוֹ לְכָל מַה שֶּׁיִּרְצֶה, הֵן בְּגַשְׁמִי הֵן בְּרוּחָנִי.
segments.en: And to explain a little: the essence of the intention is to draw to the esrog — which is the aspect of Malchus — the brain-light of the body, meaning the Chasadim [divine mercies] that are in the six extremities [of Vav ktzavos]. But it is impossible that they give illumination to the esrog except by first receiving illumination from the roots of the brain — meaning from the roots of the Chasadim that are in the Daas — and this is the secret of the shakings, see there. It is found that the essential illumination of the esrog which is the aspect of Malchus comes through the multiplication and illumination of the brain-light that is in the six extremities, through drawing to them the illumination of the brain-light that is in the head as mentioned. And this is the aspect of the above. Only there it is a literal youth and his brain remains stored in the bones and has not yet risen above to the brain as mentioned. And here in holiness — the illumination of the esrog is through drawing with intention the illumination of the brain-light that is in the head into the aspect of the body — and the brain-light of the body multiplies and illuminates, and from there the brain-light is drawn to the esrog. Understand. See there well in the Kavanos and you will understand.

segments.he:
ו.

כְּשֶׁאָדָם לוֹבֵשׁ לְבוּשׁ שֶׁל אָבִיו, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה בְּנָקֵל לוֹ לֵילֵךְ בְּמִדּוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָבִיו.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the Sukkah: for "Israel is a youth and I love him" (Hoshea 11:1). This love is the aspect of the right — the aspect of the embrace of the right hand — the aspect of Sukkah. And this comes about through the aspect of "Israel is a youth" — the aspect of a lad weeping as mentioned above.

segments.he:
ז.

לְ'כוּ לַ'חֲמוּ בְ'לַחְמִי וּ'שְׁתוּ רָאשֵׁי-תֵבוֹת לוּלָב "בְּיֵין" עִם הָאוֹתִיּוֹת - גִּימַטְרִיָּא רָאשֵׁי-תֵבוֹת שֶׁל אֶ'תְרוֹג הֲ'דַס עֲ'רָבָה, "מָסַכְתִּי" זוּ בְּחִינַת סֻכּוֹת. עַל-יְדֵי מִצְוַת נְטִילַת אַרְבָּעָה מִינִים וְעַל-יְדֵי סֻכָּה - אָדָם זוֹכֶה לַאֲכִילָה וּשְׁתִיָּה וּמַלְבּוּשִׁים וְגַם לְחִיּוּת הַנְּשָׁמָה, עַל-יְדֵי סֻכָּה זוֹכֶה לְמַלְבּוּשִׁים, בְּחִינַת "בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבוּשׁוֹ"ִ עַל-יְדֵי עַרְבֵי נַחַל זוֹכֶה לִשְׁתִיָּה, עַל-יְדֵי הֲדַס זוֹכֶה לְחִיּוּת הַנְּשָׁמָה וְעַל-יְדֵי לוּלָב וְאֶתְרוֹג זוֹכֶה לַאֲכִילָה, כִּי יֵשׁ בָּהֶם פְּרִי, שֶׁהֵם מִינֵי מַאֲכָל.
segments.en:
180. RAK: This discourse was said between Yom Kippur and Succos 5570. Yemei Moharnat 29, section 39 in the vocalized edition.

aligned_segments.he: עַל-יְדֵי מִצְוַת נְטִילַת אַרְבָּעָה מִינִים וְעַל-יְדֵי סֻכָּה - אָדָם זוֹכֶה לַאֲכִילָה וּשְׁתִיָּה וּמַלְבּוּשִׁים וְגַם לְחִיּוּת הַנְּשָׁמָה, עַל-יְדֵי סֻכָּה זוֹכֶה לְמַלְבּוּשִׁים, בְּחִינַת "בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבוּשׁוֹ"ִ עַל-יְדֵי עַרְבֵי נַחַל זוֹכֶה לִשְׁתִיָּה, עַל-יְדֵי הֲדַס זוֹכֶה לְחִיּוּת הַנְּשָׁמָה וְעַל-יְדֵי לוּלָב וְאֶתְרוֹג זוֹכֶה לַאֲכִילָה, כִּי יֵשׁ בָּהֶם פְּרִי, שֶׁהֵם מִינֵי מַאֲכָל.
aligned_segments.en: Yemei Moharnat 29, section 39 in the vocalized edition. When a man dresses in his father’s clothes, through this it is easy for him to practice his father’s traits.
